<USER_REQUEST>
Act as a senior Python cloud engineer. Create a complete academic prototype called “StreamWave Serverless Media Platform” using Python 3.12 and FastAPI.
This implementation is being assessed as a SERVERLESS APPLICATION deployed on Vercel. Do not use Docker, Django, Flask, SQLite or a traditional continuously running server.
Before editing, inspect the current project directory and preserve any unrelated existing files.
FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS
Build a responsive web interface for a fictional Zimbabwean entertainment company called StreamWave Entertainment.
Users must be able to:
View a catalogue of movies and music.
Search by title.
Filter by media type and genre.
View media details.
Play at least one small demonstration audio file using an HTML5 player.
Provide these FastAPI endpoints:
GET /api/health
GET /api/media
GET /api/media/{media_id}
POST /api/play-events
The media endpoint must support optional query, type and genre parameters.
Use Pydantic models for input and response validation.
POST /api/play-events must validate the media ID, generate a server-side timestamp and write a structured JSON playback event to the Python logger. Do not pretend the event is permanently stored.
Keep the demonstration media catalogue in a read-only data/media.json file.
Generate a short original demonstration WAV audio file using a Python standard-library script so that no copyrighted media is used.
Do not write to the application filesystem during runtime because Vercel Functions use an ephemeral/read-only filesystem.
Do not send the audio file through a FastAPI function. The browser must retrieve it directly as a static asset.
USER INTERFACE
Create a polished streaming-platform interface using HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript. Use a dark graphite background, restrained red accent colour, strong typography and clean rectangular content cards. Avoid excessive gradients, glassmorphism, oversized rounded corners and generic AI-generated styling.
Include:
StreamWave navigation and logo text.
Featured-content section.
Search box.
Movie and music filters.
Responsive media-card grid.
Accessible media-details dialog.
HTML5 audio player.
Loading, empty and error states.
Small “Serverless Demonstration” indicator.
Mobile and desktop layouts.
PROJECT STRUCTURE
Use a clear structure containing:
app.py
data/media.json
public/index.html
public/css/styles.css
public/js/app.js
public/media/demo.wav
scripts/generate_demo_audio.py
tests/test_api.py
requirements.txt
pyproject.toml
.gitignore
README.md
The root app.py must export app = FastAPI(...) from a Vercel-supported entry point. Register all /api routes before mounting the public directory. Make the public directory work locally and after deployment.
TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
Pin Python to version 3.12 in pyproject.toml.
Use FastAPI, Uvicorn, Pydantic, pytest and the required testing dependency.
Use pathlib for safe file locations.
Add appropriate response models and HTTP status codes.
Return 404 for unknown media IDs.
Apply maximum lengths to user-provided fields.
Add basic security response headers.
Do not enable unrestricted CORS because the frontend and API use the same origin.
Do not include passwords, tokens or API keys.
Keep all media small enough for an academic free-tier demonstration.
Include structured application logging.
Provide automatic Swagger documentation at /docs.
TESTING
Write automated tests covering:
Health endpoint.
Complete media catalogue.
Search and filtering.
Valid media details.
Unknown media returning 404.
Valid playback event.
Invalid playback event.
Run the audio-generation script, install dependencies and run all tests. Fix every failure. Then run the application locally and verify the interface and API.
Do not merely describe the files. Create the complete working project and finish by reporting:
Files created.
Tests executed and their actual results.
Local command for running the application.
Any limitation that still remains.
Use the current official Vercel FastAPI guidance:
[https://vercel.com/docs/frameworks/backend/fastapi](https://vercel.com/docs/frameworks/backend/fastapi)
</USER_REQUEST>

# Implementation Plan: StreamWave Serverless Media Platform

Build a complete academic prototype for **StreamWave Entertainment** (a fictional Zimbabwean entertainment platform) using **Python 3.12** and **FastAPI**, designed for serverless deployment on **Vercel**.

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - **Deployment Architecture**: Built specifically for Vercel Functions (ephemeral, read-only runtime). No continuous background servers, SQLite, or file writing at runtime.
> - **Static Asset Handling**: Demonstration WAV audio is served directly as a static file (`/media/demo.wav`) from the `public/` directory rather than streamed through FastAPI routes.
> - **CORS & Origin**: Standard same-origin configuration for Vercel deployment where the API endpoints (`/api/...`) and static frontend reside on the same origin.

## Proposed Changes

### 1. Configuration & Dependencies

#### [NEW] [pyproject.toml](file:///c:/Users/dell/.gemini/antigravity/conversations/pyproject.toml)
- Define project metadata, set `requires-python = ">=3.12, <3.13"`.
- Configure `pytest` settings.

#### [NEW] [requirements.txt](file:///c:/Users/dell/.gemini/antigravity/conversations/requirements.txt)
- Pin core dependencies: `fastapi`, `uvicorn`, `pydantic`, `pytest`, `httpx`.

#### [NEW] [.gitignore](file:///c:/Users/dell/.gemini/antigravity/conversations/.gitignore)
- Ignore `__pycache__`, `.pytest_cache`, `.venv`, environment files, and local build artifacts.

---

### 2. Audio Generation Script

#### [NEW] [scripts/generate_demo_audio.py](file:///c:/Users/dell/.gemini/antigravity/conversations/scripts/generate_demo_audio.py)
- Use standard library modules (`wave`, `struct`, `math`) to generate a 3-second multi-frequency synthesized musical chime (PCM 16-bit 44.1kHz mono WAV).
- Save generated audio directly to `public/media/demo.wav`.

---

### 3. Data Catalogue

#### [NEW] [data/media.json](file:///c:/Users/dell/.gemini/antigravity/conversations/data/media.json)
- Store a read-only catalogue of Zimbabwean movies and music items with fields: `id`, `title`, `artist_or_director`, `type` (`movie` or `music`), `genre`, `year`, `duration`, `description`, `cover_image`, `media_url`.

---

### 4. Backend Application & API Endpoints

#### [NEW] [app.py](file:///c:/Users/dell/.gemini/antigravity/conversations/app.py)
- Initialize FastAPI app with metadata and security response headers middleware (`X-Content-Type-Options`, `X-Frame-Options`, `X-XSS-Protection`).
- Pydantic models for validation and serialization:
  - `HealthResponse`
  - `MediaItem`
  - `PlayEventRequest` (with string length bounds)
  - `PlayEventResponse`
- Endpoints:
  - `GET /api/health` -> Status and serverless environment info.
  - `GET /api/media` -> Filtered/searched catalogue listing (query, type, genre params).
  - `GET /api/media/{media_id}` -> Detail lookup with HTTP 404 for unknown items.
  - `POST /api/play-events` -> Validate `media_id`, generate server timestamp, log JSON event with `logger.info`, return status.
- Mount `public/` directory for static files at root `/` with fallback index support for local Uvicorn runs and Vercel compatibility.

---

### 5. Frontend Interface

#### [NEW] [public/index.html](file:///c:/Users/dell/.gemini/antigravity/conversations/public/index.html)
- Clean, semantic HTML layout: Navigation bar with StreamWave brand & serverless badge, hero featured section, search/filter toolbar, responsive grid container, media detail `<dialog>`, and fixed HTML5 audio player.

#### [NEW] [public/css/styles.css](file:///c:/Users/dell/.gemini/antigravity/conversations/public/css/styles.css)
- Dark graphite theme (`#121214`), restrained red accent (`#e50914`), clean rectangular cards, crisp typography, responsive CSS Grid / Flexbox layout.

#### [NEW] [public/js/app.js](file:///c:/Users/dell/.gemini/antigravity/conversations/public/js/app.js)
- Vanilla JavaScript application:
  - Fetch media from `/api/media` with query/type/genre parameters.
  - Render cards dynamically.
  - Audio playback control with HTML5 `<audio>` element.
  - Automatic `POST /api/play-events` trigger on track play.
  - Accessible modal dialog handlers.
  - UI states: loading spinner, empty states, error notifications.

---

### 6. Automated Testing & Documentation

#### [NEW] [tests/test_api.py](file:///c:/Users/dell/.gemini/antigravity/conversations/tests/test_api.py)
- Pytest suite testing:
  - `/api/health`
  - `/api/media` (full catalogue, search, type filtering, genre filtering)
  - `/api/media/{media_id}` (valid & 404 cases)
  - `/api/play-events` (valid event logging & 404 unknown media & 422 validation error cases)

#### [NEW] [README.md](file:///c:/Users/dell/.gemini/antigravity/conversations/README.md)
- Complete technical documentation, setup steps, local execution instructions, Vercel configuration, API overview, and architectural highlights.

---

## Verification Plan

### Automated Tests
- Run `python scripts/generate_demo_audio.py` to create `public/media/demo.wav`.
- Run `pytest tests/test_api.py` to verify API logic, filtering, validation, and error responses.

### Manual Verification
- Code review of Pydantic models, FastAPI routes, and static file mounting to ensure Vercel compatibility and compliance with requirements.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Audio generation script for StreamWave Serverless Media Platform.
Generates an original 3-second PCM 16-bit mono 44.1kHz WAV audio file
using Python standard-library modules (wave, struct, math) to ensure
no copyrighted media is used.
"""

import math
import struct
import wave
from pathlib import Path

# Path configuration relative to this script's directory
SCRIPT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROJECT_ROOT = SCRIPT_DIR.parent
OUTPUT_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "public" / "media"
OUTPUT_FILE = OUTPUT_DIR / "demo.wav"


def generate_chime_wav(output_path: Path) -> None:
    """Generates a pleasant 3-second synthesized chord chime WAV file."""
    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    sample_rate = 44100  # Hz
    duration = 3.0  # seconds
    total_samples = int(sample_rate * duration)

    # Note frequencies for a harmonic pentatonic sequence (C5, E5, G5, C6)
    frequencies = [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.50]
    note_stagger = int(sample_rate * 0.15)  # 150ms delay between notes

    # Open WAV file for writing
    with wave.open(str(output_path), "wb") as wav_file:
        wav_file.setnchannels(1)  # Mono
        wav_file.setsampwidth(2)  # 16-bit (2 bytes per sample)
        wav_file.setframerate(sample_rate)

        frames = bytearray()
        for i in range(total_samples):
            t = i / sample_rate
            sample_val = 0.0

            # Sum active harmonics
            for note_idx, freq in enumerate(frequencies):
                start_sample = note_idx * note_stagger
                if i >= start_sample:
                    note_t = (i - start_sample) / sample_rate
                    # Envelope: gentle attack (10ms) and exponential decay
                    attack = min(1.0, note_t / 0.01)
                    decay = math.exp(-2.5 * note_t)
                    envelope = attack * decay

                    # Fundamental tone + subtle 2nd harmonic
                    tone = math.sin(2.0 * math.pi * freq * note_t) + 0.3 * math.sin(
                        4.0 * math.pi * freq * note_t
                    )
                    sample_val += tone * envelope * 0.25

            # Overall master fade-out near the end
            fade_out_start = total_samples - int(sample_rate * 0.2)
            if i > fade_out_start:
                fade_out_t = (total_samples - i) / int(sample_rate * 0.2)
                sample_val *= fade_out_t

            # Clamp and convert to 16-bit signed integer (-32768 to 32767)
            clamped = max(-1.0, min(1.0, sample_val))
            int_sample = int(clamped * 32767.0)

            # Pack as 16-bit little-endian integer
            frames.extend(struct.pack("<h", int_sample))

        wav_file.writeframes(frames)

    print(f"✅ Demo WAV audio generated successfully at: {output_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    generate_chime_wav(OUTPUT_FILE)

import json
import logging
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Optional

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Path as PathParam, Query, Request, status
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

# Configure structured Python logger
logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(name)s: %(message)s"
)
logger = logging.getLogger("streamwave")

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DATA_FILE = BASE_DIR / "data" / "media.json"
PUBLIC_DIR = BASE_DIR / "public"


def load_media_catalogue() -> List[dict]:
    """Loads read-only media catalogue from data/media.json using pathlib."""
    if not DATA_FILE.exists():
        logger.error(f"Media catalogue file not found at {DATA_FILE}")
        return []
    with open(DATA_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)


# --- Pydantic Validation Models ---


class HealthResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str = Field(..., example="ok")
    platform: str = Field(..., example="StreamWave Serverless Media Platform")
    environment: str = Field(..., example="Vercel Serverless")
    timestamp: str = Field(..., example="2026-08-25T17:25:30Z")


class MediaItem(BaseModel):
    id: str = Field(..., example="mov-001")
    title: str = Field(..., example="Cook Off")
    artist_or_director: str = Field(..., example="Tomas Brickhill")
    type: str = Field(..., example="movie")
    genre: str = Field(..., example="Comedy")
    year: int = Field(..., example=2017)
    duration: str = Field(..., example="1h 41m")
    description: str = Field(...)
    cover_image: Optional[str] = None
    media_url: Optional[str] = None


class PlayEventRequest(BaseModel):
    media_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=50)
    session_id: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=100)
    client_timestamp: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=100)


class PlayEventDetail(BaseModel):
    media_id: str
    session_id: Optional[str] = None
    client_timestamp: Optional[str] = None
    server_timestamp: str
    media_title: str


class PlayEventResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str = "recorded"
    event: PlayEventDetail


# --- FastAPI Application ---

app = FastAPI(
    title="StreamWave Serverless Media Platform API",
    description="FastAPI Backend for StreamWave Entertainment - Academic Prototype",
    version="1.0.0",
    docs_url="/docs",
    redoc_url="/redoc",
)


# Security Response Headers Middleware
@app.middleware("http")
async def add_security_headers(request: Request, call_next):
    response = await call_next(request)
    response.headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff"
    response.headers["X-Frame-Options"] = "DENY"
    response.headers["X-XSS-Protection"] = "1; mode=block"
    response.headers["Referrer-Policy"] = "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
    return response


# --- API Routes (Registered BEFORE Static File Mounting) ---


@app.get("/api/health", response_model=HealthResponse, tags=["Health"])
async def get_health():
    """Returns platform health status and serverless environment info."""
    return HealthResponse(
        status="ok",
        platform="StreamWave Serverless Media Platform",
        environment="Vercel Serverless",
        timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    )


@app.get("/api/media", response_model=List[MediaItem], tags=["Media"])
async def get_media(
    query: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, max_length=100),
    type: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, max_length=20),
    genre: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, max_length=50),
):
    """Retrieves media catalogue with optional search query, type, and genre filters."""
    catalogue = load_media_catalogue()
    results = catalogue

    if type:
        target_type = type.strip().lower()
        results = [
            item for item in results if item.get("type", "").lower() == target_type
        ]

    if genre:
        target_genre = genre.strip().lower()
        results = [
            item for item in results if item.get("genre", "").lower() == target_genre
        ]

    if query:
        q = query.strip().lower()
        results = [
            item
            for item in results
            if q in item.get("title", "").lower()
            or q in item.get("artist_or_director", "").lower()
            or q in item.get("description", "").lower()
            or q in item.get("genre", "").lower()
        ]

    return results


@app.get("/api/media/{media_id}", response_model=MediaItem, tags=["Media"])
async def get_media_detail(media_id: str = PathParam(..., max_length=50)):
    """Retrieves single media item by ID or returns HTTP 404."""
    catalogue = load_media_catalogue()
    for item in catalogue:
        if item.get("id") == media_id:
            return item
    raise HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
        detail="Media item not found",
    )


@app.post(
    "/api/play-events",
    response_model=PlayEventResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
    tags=["Playback Events"],
)
async def create_play_event(payload: PlayEventRequest):
    """
    Validates playback event, generates server timestamp, and logs structured JSON
    to Python logger without writing to ephemeral filesystem.
    """
    catalogue = load_media_catalogue()
    media_item = next(
        (item for item in catalogue if item.get("id") == payload.media_id), None
    )
    if not media_item:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="Media item not found",
        )

    server_ts = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    event_detail = PlayEventDetail(
        media_id=payload.media_id,
        session_id=payload.session_id,
        client_timestamp=payload.client_timestamp,
        server_timestamp=server_ts,
        media_title=media_item.get("title", ""),
    )

    # Log structured JSON playback event
    logger.info(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "event_type": "playback_started",
                "media_id": payload.media_id,
                "media_title": media_item.get("title", ""),
                "session_id": payload.session_id,
                "client_timestamp": payload.client_timestamp,
                "server_timestamp": server_ts,
            }
        )
    )

    return PlayEventResponse(status="recorded", event=event_detail)


# --- Static Files Mounting for Local & Production Serving ---

if PUBLIC_DIR.exists():
    app.mount("/", StaticFiles(directory=str(PUBLIC_DIR), html=True), name="public")

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app import app

client = TestClient(app)


def test_health_endpoint():
    """Tests GET /api/health returns 200 OK and expected serverless metadata."""
    response = client.get("/api/health")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()
    assert data["status"] == "ok"
    assert "StreamWave" in data["platform"]
    assert "environment" in data
    assert "timestamp" in data


def test_get_complete_media_catalogue():
    """Tests GET /api/media returns full catalogue array."""
    response = client.get("/api/media")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    items = response.json()
    assert isinstance(items, list)
    assert len(items) >= 4
    for item in items:
        assert "id" in item
        assert "title" in item
        assert "type" in item
        assert "genre" in item


def test_media_search_filter():
    """Tests GET /api/media with query string parameter."""
    response = client.get("/api/media?query=Cook")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    items = response.json()
    assert len(items) > 0
    assert any("Cook" in item["title"] for item in items)


def test_media_type_filter():
    """Tests GET /api/media with type filter."""
    movie_res = client.get("/api/media?type=movie")
    assert movie_res.status_code == 200
    movies = movie_res.json()
    assert all(item["type"] == "movie" for item in movies)

    music_res = client.get("/api/media?type=music")
    assert music_res.status_code == 200
    music = music_res.json()
    assert all(item["type"] == "music" for item in music)


def test_media_genre_filter():
    """Tests GET /api/media with genre filter."""
    response = client.get("/api/media?genre=Zimdancehall")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    items = response.json()
    assert len(items) > 0
    assert all(item["genre"] == "Zimdancehall" for item in items)


def test_get_valid_media_detail():
    """Tests GET /api/media/{media_id} for a valid ID."""
    response = client.get("/api/media/mov-001")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    item = response.json()
    assert item["id"] == "mov-001"
    assert item["title"] == "Cook Off"
    assert item["type"] == "movie"


def test_get_unknown_media_detail_404():
    """Tests GET /api/media/{media_id} returns 404 for unknown ID.""\
